Differentiating a_j gives K′=12(a2²−a1a3)/a1³ <0 and K″=36(a1²a4−2a1a2a3+a2³)/a1⁴>0 via weighted squares. The support bound follows from (U−L)(H−U)≥0 and optimizing the mean, with unique two-endpoint equality. A binary intensity mixture gives the stated algebraic inverse. Existence uses exponential tail of no-reset age for μ>0 and positive-rate mass; no finite mean of ν is required.
